opening.argument: The walkthrough shows a training process, not a deceptive offer: viewers are directed to create a Microsoft account, work through the course, open its assignment, and download a completion certificate. The stated aim is to learn through Microsoft training and receive a free certificate, and the certificate shown is from Microsoft Virtual Academy. An invitation to visit an external website does not, on this record, establish a payment demand, credential collection, deception, or a victim outcome. The observable sequence supports an educational demonstration of course completion.

citations.quote: We'll learn how to get a training from Microsoft and get a free certificate.
The first thing you have to do is create an account on Microsoft.
Now here you can see that the last option you get is assignment. Just click on it.
